parameters.bodyJson:
{
  "action": "encode_video",
  "input_audio": "={{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.audio_url }}",
  "output_path": "/tmp/n8n-video/{{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}-long-form.mp4",
  "video_width": {{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.width }},
  "video_height": {{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.height }},
  "fps": {{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.fps }},
  "bitrate": "{{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.bitrate }}",
  "codec": "{{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.codec }}",
  "audio_bitrate": "{{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.audio_bitrate }}",
  "preset": "{{ $env.FFMPEG_PRESET || 'medium' }}",
  "crf": {{ $env.FFMPEG_CRF || 23 }},
  "duration": {{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.duration }},
  "background_color": "000000",
  "add_text_overlay": {{ $node['Generate - Visual Timeline'].json.text_overlay_enabled }},
  "text_content": "{{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.video_title }}",
  "timeout_seconds": 3600
}

{
  "action": "create_shorts",
  "input_video": "{{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.input_video }}",
  "output_path": "{{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.output_path }}",
  "video_width": {{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.width }},
  "video_height": {{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.height }},
  "fps": {{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.fps }},
  "bitrate": "{{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.bitrate }}",
  "max_duration": {{ $node['Create - YouTube Shorts'].json.max_duration }},
  "preset": "{{ $env.FFMPEG_PRESET || 'fast' }}",
  "crf": 24
}

{
  "long_form_video": {
    "url": "https://storage.example.com/videos/{{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}-long-form.mp4",
    "duration_seconds": {{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.audio_duration_seconds }},
    "resolution": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.long_form_video.resolution }}",
    "fps": {{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.long_form_video.fps }},
    "bitrate": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.long_form_video.bitrate }}",
    "codec": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.long_form_video.codec }}",
    "file_size_mb": {{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.long_form_video.expected_size_mb }},
    "thumbnail_url": "https://storage.example.com/thumbnails/{{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}-thumb.jpg",
    "status": "ready"
  },
  "shorts_video": {
    "url": "https://storage.example.com/shorts/{{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}-shorts.mp4",
    "duration_seconds": {{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.audio_duration_seconds }},
    "resolution": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.shorts_video.resolution }}",
    "fps": {{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.shorts_video.fps }},
    "bitrate": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.shorts_video.bitrate }}",
    "codec": "{{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.shorts_video.codec }}",
    "file_size_mb": {{ $node['Validate - Video Output'].json.shorts_video.expected_size_mb }},
    "status": "ready"
  },
  "audio_id": "={{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}",
  "script_id": "={{ $node['Process - Validate Audio'].json.script_id }}",
  "encoding_preset": "{{ $env.FFMPEG_PRESET || 'medium' }}",
  "overall_status": "video_ready_for_upload",
  "created_at": "=new Date().toISOString()"
}

=Video Creation Complete!
